checks: Confirm the review window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) and the last IDT review date; pull all encounters, ED visits, urgent care visits, and hospital admissions in the window and since enrollment (2026-01-04).
Falls and near-falls: count, injuries, and any fall-risk screening or assessment done in the window (relevant for age 75, COPD, beta-blocker use, and possible sertraline start).

Sertraline started 2026-09-13 for depressive symptoms (PHQ-9 of 14): confirm prescriber, dose, and start date; check for follow-up PHQ-9 repeat, adherence, side effects (GI upset, sleep change, dizziness, hyponatremia signs such as confusion or falls), and any bleeding signs given concurrent clopidogrel.

Mood and behavioral health: review depressive symptom trend, suicidality screening, counseling or behavioral health referrals, and attendance at PACE day programs or social activities since the sertraline start.

Cardiac status for ischemic heart disease (onset 2025-04-19): chest pain or nitroglycerin use frequency, metoprolol and clopidogrel and simvastatin adherence, any cardiology visits, and any new cardiac-related ED visits.

Respiratory status for COPD/chronic obstructive bronchitis and chronic sinusitis: exacerbations, rescue albuterol use frequency, fluticasone/salmeterol inhaler technique and adherence, oxygen saturation trend, and sinus infection treatments such as antibiotics or steroids started in the window.
Vitals trend: blood pressure and resting heart rate (on metoprolol), weight trend (BMI 30+ history, and whether weight is stable or changing), and any new edema.

Metabolic and endocrine: prediabetes follow-up (HbA1c or glucose results and dates), levothyroxine dose and TSH monitoring due dates for idiopathic atrophic hypothyroidism, and lipid panel follow-up on simvastatin.
Oncology history (breast cancer, onset 2000): confirm surveillance imaging and survivorship follow-up dates are current and any new breast or other symptoms are documented.

Chronic pain: current pain score, analgesic use and any new analgesic starts or stops in the window, and effect on function and sleep. Also check for any medication starts or stops not captured in the active list, and reconcile with pharmacy fill history.

Function, cognition, and caregiver: ADL and IADL changes since last review, cognitive screen status, caregiver availability and strain, transportation barriers, and whether any care-plan items (assessments, reassessments, service plan updates) are due or overdue by 2026-11-30.
